summary: Wednesday is the peak everywhere as an ESE/E swell fills in — Rockaway goes prime-angle to near 4ft with a cross-off dawn, so the home break delivers and there's no reason to drive that day. The one trip worth planning is Manasquan on Thursday, when it holds 3ft-plus on a prime angle and cleans up offshore all afternoon; Matunuck's clean cross-off Wednesday is the other option if you want size and glass. It fades into the weekend — small but offshore Saturday, then a flat spell Sunday into Monday.
